    Resting-state multiPPI wrapper

    mppi_rest.Rd

    Resting-state multiPPI wrapper

    mppi_rest(
  data,
  runs = NULL,
  modulators = NULL,
  include = c("states", "bursts", "envelopes"),
  basis = list(type = "pca", r = 120L),
  modulator_domain = c("auto", "bold", "neural"),
  domain = c("neural", "bold", "innovations"),
  prewhiten = TRUE,
  ar_method = "ar",
  ar_order = "auto",
  nuisance = NULL,
  attach_pk = TRUE,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    data

    Matrix or fmri_dataset providing the time series.

    runs

    Optional run labels.

    modulators

    Optional pre-built modulators; if NULL they are derived from the basis time-series.

    include

    Which modulator families to construct when modulators is NULL.

    basis

    Basis specification passed to .mppi_resolve_basis().

    modulator_domain

    Domain for building modulators ("auto", "bold", "neural").

    domain

    Domain for the final mPPI fit.

    prewhiten

    Use fmriAR prewhitening (default TRUE when available).

    ar_method, ar_order

    Controls for fmriAR noise modelling.

    nuisance

    Optional nuisance regressors aligned with the data.

    attach_pk

    Attach residualized modulator list to the returned fit.

    ...

    Passed through to mppi_fit() / mppi_fit_whitened().

    Value

    mppi_fit object.
